categories.name: First leaf
categories.metric: One-time: planting the maple at the end of onboarding. Counts once, ever.

categories.name: Hours saved
categories.metric: Hours your chosen apps stayed locked while you were awake: verified locked intervals (counted once where they overlap) inside the awake window, minus overrides and phone breaks, at most 6 h a day and 2 h from blocks that started on their own. Focus spec §3.
categories.data_source: Maple's session ledger (its own shield events), never Screen Time usage

categories.name: Sessions finished
categories.metric: Sessions the member started, planned at 20 minutes or more, that reached their planned end. At most 4 a day.

categories.name: Focus streak
categories.metric: The best run of days with a finished session. Any 2 rest days per calendar week are built in; Away pauses it.

categories.name: Phone-free mornings
categories.metric: Mornings whose Morning block ran to its end with no override, early end or phone break.

categories.name: Bedtime kept
categories.metric: Nights whose wind-down block ran to bedtime with no override, early end or phone break.

categories.name: Rested nights
categories.metric: Nights Apple Health shows the member asleep no later than 30 minutes after the scheduled bedtime (NightLedger on time).
